data.one_liner: Query Android app usage statistics, events, storage usage, and network data.
data.what_it_does: Wraps Android's UsageStatsManager, NetworkStatsManager, StorageStatsManager, and PackageManager behind a single Dart facade. It enables querying per-app foreground usage, raw events, network usage, storage statistics, and app metadata.
use_when: You are building an Android-only app that needs to monitor app usage or screen time.
You need to retrieve per-app network usage or on-device storage stats.
You need to inspect installed apps and their launch icons.
avoid_when: Your application needs to support iOS or platforms other than Android.
You want to avoid requiring users to manually grant special permissions in system settings.
strengths: Provides a comprehensive suite of Android usage statistics APIs in one plugin.
Includes typed getters on returned models to avoid manual parsing.
Degrades gracefully on older Android API levels.
weaknesses: Android only; no iOS implementation exists.
Most queries require the special PACKAGE_USAGE_STATS permission, which must be granted manually in system settings.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding the PACKAGE_USAGE_STATS permission to AndroidManifest.xml and prompting users to enable it in system settings. Targets a minimum SDK of 23.
